titulo: Take your progress to another device
lead: No account, no sign-up: your device builds a package with your progress and your notes, locks it with a key that only appears here, and the other device reads the QR and merges everything with what it already has. Nothing is erased.
segredo: The QR and the code are secrets: anyone who sees them can open the package. Show them only to your other device, and close them afterwards.
enviarTitulo: On the device that has the progress
enviarTexto: Create the QR here and read it on the other device, on the same My data screen.
vazio: There is no progress or notes saved on this device to take along.
qrAlt: QR of the progress package, to read with the other device's camera
modoDentro: The locked package is inside the QR. No server took part.
modoServidor: The locked package waited on a server, which cannot open it. It disappears as soon as it is read, or within 1 day. The QR carries only the package code and the key, which never goes to the server.
codigoRotulo: If the camera cannot read it, type this code on the other device:
receberTitulo: On the device that will receive
receberTexto: Read the other device's QR with the camera, or type the code. What arrives is merged with what is already here.
lerQr: Read the QR with the camera
cameraAviso: Point the camera at the other device's QR.
codigoCampo: Code from the other device (36 letters and numbers)
feito: Done: {n} items were merged with what was already here. Nothing was erased.
nada: The package opened, but it brought nothing new for this device.
erroServico: Your progress package is large and has to go through the server, which is not available right now. Use the backup file, further up.
erroConexao: No connection to the server. Check the internet and try again.
erroMuitos: Too many requests in a row. Wait a little and try again.
erroCheio: The server has many packages waiting right now. Try again shortly or use the backup file.
erroGrande: Your progress is too large for this route. Use the backup file, further up.
erroNaoAchou: Code not found: it may already have been read, be more than a day old, or be wrong. Create another QR on the original device.
erroAbrir: I could not open the package: the key does not match or the code is incomplete.
erroCodigo: This does not look like a progress package code. Check the 36 characters.
erroCamera: The camera could not be opened. Type the code.
